method: Equal weight across eight variables. A Hard label is not a true-hard score. True hard means an editorial 18-point rubric total of at least 12. Elite hard means at least 15. Only the 59 new items received that editorial score. The older bank was not relabeled.

evidence.rubricMedianOfOlderBank: The previous screen of the cleaned bank had a median of 6/18. Fifty-nine new items do not move that median.

whyNot100: Reaching 75 distinct originals on every topic still requires 2,959 more questions. Fifty true-hard items on every topic would take thousands more. The running total is 59 editorial true-hard questions, 10 of them elite. That is not enough to move any variable to 95, and filling the remaining hole by repeating frames is not allowed.
